title: The Qubit and the Computational Basis
summary: State vector, normalization and the X gate on the Bloch sphere.
mission: Apply a gate to qubit 0 to take it from state |0⟩ to state |1⟩.
hints: The circuit is already created in the variable qc. Gates are its methods: qc.gate_name(qubit_index).
The gate that swaps |0⟩ and |1⟩ is the Pauli-X, the quantum equivalent of NOT.
Write qc.x(0) on a new line, after the circuit is created. Note: qc.y(0) and qc.rx(pi, 0) also pass, because they differ from X only by a global phase, which cannot be observed.

prediction.question: Before writing any code: the X gate rotates the state vector by 180° around the sphere's X axis. Starting at the north pole (|0⟩), where does the vector end up?
options: It stays at the north pole, in |0⟩
prediction.explanation: A half turn around a horizontal axis takes the north pole to the south pole. That is why X is the quantum NOT: it swaps |0⟩ and |1⟩.
